properties.name: dc.platform.core.correlation.header-name
properties.description: Removed: the correlation id is the W3C trace ID and travels in the standard traceparent header, so there is no custom header to configure.

deprecation.reason: Correlation is the W3C trace ID (traceparent); custom correlation headers are no longer read or written.

properties.name: dc.platform.core.correlation.generate-if-missing
properties.description: Removed: a request without a valid traceparent always starts a new trace, whose trace ID is the correlation id.

deprecation.reason: The tracing bridge always starts a new trace when traceparent is missing or invalid.
